issues.description: validate_conda uses unanchored substring match on --version output, accepting non-conda binaries
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. `if any(tool in out.decode().lower() ...)` matches anywhere in the output, so wrapper scripts or tools whose banner mentions 'conda'/'mamba' pass. Anchor the check to the first whitespace-separated token or use startswith so the validator actually verifies identity.

issues.description: filters='*.exe' on the browse dialog breaks the picker on Linux and macOS
issues.detail: Unanimously flagged. Conda/mamba/micromamba are extensionless on Unix, so the file dialog hides every valid binary on the platforms where users most need this escape hatch. Make the filter platform-conditional (only `*.exe` on Windows) or use 'All files'.

issues.description: custom_conda boolean plus conda_path string encodes one decision as two settings
issues.detail: Hickey and Torvalds note that `custom_conda=True` with empty/garbage `conda_path` is a meaningless state that kernelspec.py silently treats as 'no custom'. Collapse to one `Optional[Path]` value, or at minimum validate the path before handing it to downstream code in the kernelspec fallback.

issues.description: run_program(...).communicate() has no timeout and can hang on a wedged user-supplied binary
issues.detail: Knuth and Torvalds both flag that validating a user-typed path spawns a subprocess with no timeout. A misconfigured or hung binary blocks the preferences page indefinitely. Add a timeout to communicate() and kill the child on expiry; consider validating on focus-out rather than every keystroke.

issues.description: validate_conda('') returning True conflates 'empty is acceptable' with 'valid executable'
issues.detail: Hickey and Torvalds flag that the empty-string special case papers over UI quietness at the cost of lying about validity. An empty path is not a valid Conda executable; the caller should decide what to do with empty input. Separate the edit-time and launch-time semantics.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is the right shape of patch but lands with sloppy validation. Three issues are unanimous: an unanchored substring match in `validate_conda`, a Windows-only `*.exe` filter that breaks the browse dialog on Linux/macOS, and the broader pattern of cross-platform inattention. Two reviewers additionally flag that `custom_conda` + `conda_path` encodes one decision as two settings with a meaningless intermediate state, that the validator can hang on a user-supplied binary without a timeout, and that returning True for the empty string lies about validity. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — fix the validator, platform-gate the filter, and tighten the config shape before landing.
